description: This file defines the 'PdfNameDictionary' class, which manages named destinations and embedded files within a PDF document, extending 'PdfDictionary' with specific methods for adding destinations and embedded files, and contains nested 'Keys' class for dictionary keys.

classes.name: PdfNameDictionary
classes.description: Represents a specialized PDF dictionary for managing named destinations and embedded files in a PDF document.

classes.name: PdfNameDictionary.Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for the PdfNameDictionary, such as '/Dests' for named destinations and '/EmbeddedFiles' for embedded file streams.

methods.name: AddNamedDestination
methods.description: Adds a named destination to the dictionary, creating a new destination array referencing a specific page and parameters.

methods.name: AddEmbeddedFile
methods.description: Adds an embedded file stream to the PDF, associating a name with the file data stored in the PDF structure.
